title: One full builder for everyone, no level switch (G-17-1)
reference_behaviour: The builder shows every control to every user at once: summary figures, all chart tabs, Greeks, IV, what-if and settings. There is no beginner/advanced switch; features are gated by paid plan only.
ours: REQ-006 AC-1 to AC-4 still give three levels and a Preferences switch, and the builder takes a guided, standard or advanced level. ADR-168 (4)(5) removes it: rewrite the spec first (row 17).
